raw_text: The farmer protest AI images are a worrying development. Using synthetic crowd photos to inflate protest numbers undermines the credibility of a legitimate movement. Both sides of the political spectrum are now weaponizing generative AI. The real farmer march has tens of thousands of actual participants, making the fake images unnecessary and counterproductive.
